steps: Invoke the equipment-query Skill (get_equipment Tool) with the input "查询 PUMP-001 的状态、温度、来源并提供建议。" under the equipment-normal scenario and require the run to succeed.
Inspect the returned report and verify schema equipment-report@1 with exactly the facts source=seed-equipment-001@1, status=warning, equipmentId=PUMP-001, and temperatureCelsius=86.
Verify against the recording transport that no write calls were made (write-call-count equals 0) and that only the four original response fields are present.
Invoke the equipment-query Skill with the input "请查询设备状态。" under the equipment-missing-id scenario and require the run to succeed.
Verify the response explicitly asks the caller to supply an equipmentId before any query is attempted.
Verify against the recording transport that zero business calls occurred (all-business-call-count equals 0).
Configure the mock equipment transport to the read-timeout fault, then invoke the equipment-query Skill with the input "查询 PUMP-001 的状态。" and require the run to succeed.
Inspect the run output and verify it contains explicit tool-error evidence for the timeout and does not assert any equipment status, temperature, or source facts.
Verify against the recording transport that the read attempt can fail but zero write calls were made (write-call-count equals 0).
